decisions.reason: The polymer concrete drain housing had its own page in both years and complements the compatible product families at low carrying cost, so its option value remains.
Floor-level shower drainage is core to the firm's direction, and its visibility grew from a mention in 2018 to its own page in 2019, suggesting the option is resolving favorably.
The designer flagship slipped from its own page to a mere mention, a weakening signal, but it fits the design-oriented strategy and is cheap to keep in a modular range while demand stays uncertain.
The shower element with integrated slope was only ever mentioned, so its value is still uncertain, but it aligns with the low-profile, accessible trend and costs little to keep.
The backflow-protected basement drain moved from its own page to the home page, signaling strong prospects that justify further commitment.
The air-admittance valve is a peripheral accessory with low visibility, but it rounds out the system offering at minimal carrying cost, so keeping it is cheaper than dropping it.
